                case KV3BinaryNodeType.BINARY_BLOB:
                    var length = reader.ReadInt32();
                    // vpkstuff patch: ReadBytes allocates the requested length before reading, and
                    // the length comes from the file; it must fit the data left.
                    if (length < 0 || length > reader.BaseStream.Length - reader.BaseStream.Position)
                    {
                        throw new InvalidDataException($"KV3 binary blob declares {length} bytes; refusing to parse (malformed or hostile resource).");
                    }

                    return reader.ReadBytes(length);
                case KV3BinaryNodeType.ARRAY:
                    var arrayLength = reader.ReadInt32();
                    var array = KVObject.Array(Math.Clamp(arrayLength, 0, 4096)); // vpkstuff patch: a length from the file is only a capacity hint here

                    for (var i = 0; i < arrayLength; i++)
                    {
                        LegacyParseBinaryKV3(context, reader, array);
                    }

                    return array;
                case KV3BinaryNodeType.ARRAY_TYPED:
                    var typeArrayLength = reader.ReadInt32();
                    var (subType, subFlagInfo) = LegacyReadType(reader);
                    var typedArray = KVObject.Array(Math.Clamp(typeArrayLength, 0, 4096)); // vpkstuff patch: a length from the file is only a capacity hint here

                    for (var i = 0; i < typeArrayLength; i++)
                    {
                        typedArray.Add(LegacyReadBinaryValue(context, subType, subFlagInfo, reader));
                    }

                    return typedArray;
                case KV3BinaryNodeType.OBJECT:
                    var objectLength = reader.ReadInt32();
                    var newObject = KVObject.Collection(Math.Clamp(objectLength, 0, 4096)); // vpkstuff patch: a length from the file is only a capacity hint here
